(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A method of using a finger palette to transfer cosmetics from a container to a destination, a. the finger palette including: i. a ring portion that is securable to a finger; and ii. a surface portion secured to the ring portion, the surface portion being at least substantially smooth to allow a user to spread or blend cosmetic product on the surface portion; b. the method including the steps of: i. securing the finger palette to a finger; ii. depositing a cosmetic product onto the surface portion of the finger palette; and iii. transferring the cosmetic product from the surface portion of the finger palette to a destination, wherein the surface portion includes at least one feature that facilitates cleaning of the surface portion.

(Currently Amended) Claim 4: The method of claim 1 wherein: a. a first quantity of the cosmetic product is deposited onto the surface portion; and b. a second quantity of the cosmetic product is transferred from the surface portion to the destination, the second quantity being smaller than the first quantity, and wherein the first quantity is larger than the quantity of cosmetics that would typically be used in a single application.

(Currently Amended) Claim 6: The method of claim 1 wherein the surface portion is at least substantially free from protrusions extending therefrom, such that the cosmetic product can be easily spread across the entire surface without obstruction.

(Currently Amended) Claim 7: The method of claim 1 wherein the surface portion is at least substantially smooth and planar. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: The method of claim 1 wherein the finger palette is secured to the finger by passing the finger through the ring portion, and the ring portion is adjustable to accommodate fingers of different sizes.
